summary: Crop picked up: 7,252.64 t FFB Jan–Sep 2026 (Agro); yield as of September 10.51 t/ha vs 9.26 t/ha same period 2025, up 13.40%, but most fields remain well below expectation.
To June (PA): 4,161.98 t vs 4,805 t budget, 5.67 t/ha vs 6.54; cost RM380.85/t FFB within the RM385.63/t to-date budget.

issues.title: Rat census statement vs PA table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 6.8.1(b) says no follow-up rat damage census was done, yet the PA rat census table shows June 2026 pre-treatment damage of 18% (PM12D), 19% (PM16E), 18% (PM18F), 17% (PM20G) and 19% (PR22H), with baiting in June. Agronomy 1/2026 (Q1) had only PM16E, PM18F, PM20G censused.

issues.title: YTD yield decline is an area effect
issues.detail: PA 8.2 says yield to June is 11% below 2025 (5.67 vs 6.35 t/ha), but tonnage is actually up 2.5% (4,161.98 t vs 4,060.71 t). The fall is because mature area rose from 639.35 to 734.35 ha with P22H (96 ha, 2022 planting) now counted.

issues.title: Harvester count inconsistent within PA
issues.detail: PA labour table (June 2026) shows 26 harvesters vs 37 required (short 11); PA 3.1 says 28 available as at July at 1:20 ha, short 9; 3.2-3.3 revise the requirement to 41 at 1:18 ha (short 13); 3.4 says that with 2 recruits by 13/8/26 the estate would still be short 11. Agronomy 1/2026 (April) reported a shortage of six harvesters.

issues.title: Planting years wrong in PA area statement
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 area table lists PM00A/PM01B as 1995, PM02C/PM12D 2000, PM16E 2001, PM18F 2002, PM20G 2012; Agronomy 1/2026 gives 2000, 2001, 2002, 2012, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2022 respectively, which matches the PA's own bunch-weight table and field codes.

issues.title: Annual budget hectarage typo
issues.detail: PA crop table shows annual-budget hectarage 639.35 ha, but the annual budget yield 14.09 t/ha only reconciles with 734.35 ha (10,350 t / 734.35).

issues.title: Date typo in manuring table
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 manuring table: PM18F 0.75 kg/palm application dated 19.06.26 but completed 17.06.26 (completion before start). Report's comments page is also headed 'PA REPORT 1- 2026' although it is report 2/2026.

issues.title: Agro 2/2026 Table 6: 2025 total does not add up
issues.detail: Table 6 prints 2025 total 8,798.0 t but its twelve months add to 8,752.04 t (46 t less). 2024 (9,140.05 t) and 2026 (7,252.64 t) do add up. PA 1/2026 Dec field table gave 8,675.13 t (mature fields only). Dec 2025 is 814.39 t in Table 6 vs 783.58 t in PA 1/2026. Jan–Jun 2025 adds to 4,051.59 t vs 4,060.71 t in PA 2/2026 same-period column.

issues.title: Table 17 yield base differs from planted area
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 17 totals 690.35 ha with P22 at 52.00 ha, whereas Table 1 and PA 2/2026 give 734.35 ha with P22 at 96.00 ha. Printed 10.51 t/ha is on the 690.35 ha base, so it should not be compared directly with PA yields on 734.35 ha (PA 5.67 t/ha to June).

issues.title: Replanting: PA vs Agronomy
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 2.2 says no replanting plans for 2026 and 2027. Agro 2/2026 Table 2 schedules PM00A 160.63 ha in 2027 (tentative, para 2.1) and PM01B 68.00 ha in 2028; 7.10 separately says P00B and P00C should be replanted within the next five years.

issues.title: Bagworm statements conflict inside Agro 2/2026
issues.detail: 7.9 names outbreaks in P12, P16 and P18, 'currently under control'. But Table 10 shows 0 for P12 and P16 and 4.5.7 says under control; 5.17-5.19 and Table 14 show outbreaks in P18 and P20 at threshold in June 2026 with no follow-up treatment. P20 is missing from 7.9.

issues.title: Bagworm spray month
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 5.19 says cypermethrin was sprayed in P18F in February 2026; Table 15 shows the 10.65 ha in March.

issues.title: Rat after-treatment census: PA vs Agronomy
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 12 shows after-treatment census for PM18F 16%, 9%, 8% and PM20G 9%, 9%. PA 2/2026 6.8 table shows after-treatment 0% and 6.8.1(b) says no follow-up census was done. Agro 5.16 says no census since July 2026, though its tables show the last non-zero census in June 2026.

issues.title: Wrong fields in young mature section
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 5.8, in the P18/P20 section, says second circle rounds overdue in P01B and P12D. Those are mature fields (see 4.4.3); it looks copied from section 4.

issues.title: Next visit date typo
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 8.4 says next agronomy visit is scheduled for the first half of 2026; this must mean 2027.

issues.title: RP outstanding list differs
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 3.3b lists RP outstanding in P12D, P18F, P20G and P22H; Table 5 and 3.6 list only P20G and P22H. PA shows P12D RP in progress from 29.06.26 and P18F RP with no date.

issues.title: Pruning: PA vs Agronomy
issues.detail: PM02C 93.27% (2.14 ha left) to Jun in PA 6.5 vs 77% with about 7 ha outstanding in Agro 4.3.5; PM18F 96.80% in PA vs 86% as of Aug in Agro 5.7. PA unpruned column adds to 158.94 ha; Agro 4.3.8 says 209 ha as of Aug 2026. The Agro chart was not readable.

issues.title: P22 mature or immature
issues.detail: PA 2/2026 2.1 declares PR22H (96 ha) mature in 2026; Agro 2/2026 still reports it under immature plantings, heading '97HA' while Table 1 gives 96.00 ha.

issues.title: Labour view differs
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 7.11 says the labour situation improved this year; PA 2/2026 calls shortage of harvesters and sprayers the main issue (51 vs 67 workers).

issues.title: Kieserite delay wording
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 3.5 says about three months' delay in P18F and P20G; 5.2 says more than two months.

issues.title: Palm census area mismatch
issues.detail: Agro 2/2026 Table 3 block areas differ from Table 1 (e.g. PM16E 51.43 vs 42.06 ha, PM18F 73.23 vs 85.04, PM12D 136.07 vs 145.00, PM00A 153.42 vs 160.63). SPH also differs: PM02C 142 (PA pruning table) vs 132 (Agro GPS).

issues.title: Comments letter header

LADANG TAGAR 2 (Tagar Properties Sdn Bhd, Prosper group) - FACT PACK
Sources: PA Report 2/2026 (Planting Advisor Mr. Boey Chee Weng, visit 7 August 2026, review period January to June 2026) and Agronomy Report 2/2026 (Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, visit 29 September 2026, previous visit 9 April 2026, cover letter 29 October 2026, Plantation Controller Dr. Chua Chin Kok). AREA (PA 2/2026, as at June 2026): Title 770.49 ha. Planted 734.35 ha, all mature (95.31%). Roads 23.95 ha, TNB rentice 1.19 ha, buildings/others 11.00 ha. No immature, replanting or nursery. Mature area rose from 639.35 ha to 734.35 ha because PR22H (96 ha) was declared mature in 2026. PA says no replanting plans for 2026 and 2027. Agronomy 2/2026: planted 734.35 ha (Table 1). P00 replanting tentatively 2027 (PM00A 160.63 ha), to be finalised early so manuring can be withdrawn; PM01B 68.00 ha in 2028 (Table 2). P00B and P00C are over 25 years, tall, under 15 MT/ha for years, with poor ravine access; to be replanted within five years. Palm census unchanged (GPS SPH): PM00A 128 and 122, PM01B 113, PM02C 132, PM12D 135 and 133, PM16E 136, PM18F 120, PM20G 126, PR22H 120. LABOUR (PA 2/2026, June 2026): Total workers 51 vs 67 required (short 16): 16 local estate check-roll, 2 foreign check-roll, 33 contract workers (all 26 harvesters, 4 sprayers and 2 driver/loaders are contract). Harvesters 26 vs 37 (short 11). Sprayers 4 vs 8 (short 4). Manuring 9 workers plus 1 mandore (adequate). Driver plus loader 2 vs 3. Worker ratio 1:14 ha vs ideal 1:12 ha. Contractors: KT Palm, Dhaanika, MD Enterprise, Monirul, CK Permai, AK Guhan, Rohani Osman. Advised to engage a Bangladeshi contractor for spraying; Indonesian workers no longer interested in spraying. Housing issue with Labour Department: no progress reported. Agronomy 2/2026 says the labour situation improved this year, helping field maintenance, though several programmes stay behind schedule.
STAFF (PA): no change; still short one office clerk for Pinfosys (Tagar 3 clerk assisting).

MANURING: PA - 1,787 ha of 1,973 ha budgeted fertilised to June; late NK Mixture and Kieserite delivery; 20 bags/man-day broadcasting; check-roll workers at RM65.38/day. WEEDING (PA): Circle spraying 908 ha (1.2 rounds), 76% of 1,198 ha budgeted to June; 5.9 ha/man-day; RM13/ha; Glyphosate 0.61 l/ha. ROADS AND DRAINS (PA): 2,297 chains grading budgeted (RM19/chain), none done because rates not finalised due to high diesel price; 320 t crusher run bought unbudgeted at RM38/t. Desilting 260 chains of 8x6x4 (RM46), 257.5 of 12x6x4 (RM51), 175.3 of 15x6x4 (RM77), none done.
